title: PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2608.15673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with harmful prompts, or refusals to assist benign ones. To separate grounding and reasoning roles, we propose PL-Guard, a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture. Using a symbolic policy interface consisting of predicates and ProbLog rules, a local LLM grounds prompt-response pairs into predicate probabilities using renormalized True/False token scores, while ProbLog performs explicit probabilistic rule inference over the symbolic policy. On the XSTest

translated_title: PL-Guard：面向大语言模型护栏的概率逻辑推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15673v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型护栏可以被视为策略一致性问题：系统必须确定在提示-响应对中哪些与策略相关的事实成立，以及这些事实在给定策略下意味着什么。常见的方法，包括策略提示和“LLM作为裁判”的流水线，往往将语义基础化和策略推理的任务重叠：模型既解释提示-响应对，又推理策略是否被违反。这可能导致对有害提示的不安全顺从，或对良性提示的拒绝协助。为了分离基础化和推理的角色，我们提出了PL-Guard，一种神经符号护栏架构。通过由谓词和Problog规则组成的符号策略接口，本地LLM使用重新归一化的真/假令牌分数将提示-响应对基础化为谓词概率，而Problog对符号策略执行显式的概率规则推理。在XSTest上，...
tldr: PL-Guard提出了一种神经符号护栏架构，通过分离语义基础化和策略推理，利用Problog进行概率逻辑推理，以减少大语言模型在策略执行中的不安全顺从或过度拒绝问题。
en_tdlr: PL-Guard proposes a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture that separates semantic grounding and policy reasoning, using ProbLog for probabilistic logic inference to reduce unsafe compliance or over-refusal in LLM policy enforcement.
